title: entada polystachya
intro: Entada polystachya, commonly known as the "fish poison tree," is a plant species native to the tropical forests of Central and South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Entada polystachya include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and act as an antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
